articles.title: YouTube emerges as a launchpad for India’s streaming series
articles.summary: YouTube has increasingly become that proving ground, with several Indian series beginning on the open video platform before moving to subscription services as their audiences and ambitions grow. IMDb’s report, 10 Years of Streaming in India, found that 13 of the 64 unique series that appeared in its annual Top 10 charts between 2016 and 2026 began on YouTube.

articles.title: PhonePe rolls out NPS account opening with Rs 250 contribution, no fresh KYC
articles.summary: PhonePe has introduced a digital process for users to open National Pension System accounts. The service is aimed at individuals looking to start retirement planning easily and flexibly.

articles.title: Rabies vigil in K’taka border areas after surge in cases

articles.title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann flags off 100 minibuses to link villages with cities
articles.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann on Monday flagged off 100 new minibuses and reaffirmed his government's commitment to connecting every village in the state with cities, news agency Press Trust of India reported. Mann said the buses would strengthen rural connectivity, make daily travel easier and improve access to education, employment and essential services.

articles.title: India targets national debt at 50% of GDP by 2030: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
articles.summary: “We have openly stated our goal that by 2030, the national debt will be limited to 50 per cent of the GDP. We are consistently putting in place measures to reduce the Union government's debt, and international organisations have acknowledged India's disciplined approach to debt management,” she said, according to PTI.
articles.title_hi: भारत ने 2030 तक राष्ट्रीय ऋण को सकल घरेलू उत्पाद का 50% करने का लक्ष्य रखा है: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण
articles.summary_hi: पीटीआई के अनुसार, उन्होंने कहा, "हमने खुले तौर पर अपना लक्ष्य बताया है कि 2030 तक राष्ट्रीय ऋण सकल घरेलू उत्पाद के 50 प्रतिशत तक सीमित रहेगा। हम केंद्र सरकार के ऋण को कम करने के लिए लगातार उपाय कर रहे हैं और अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठनों ने ऋण प्रबंधन के लिए भारत के अनुशासित दृष्टिकोण को स्वीकार किया है।"

articles.summary_hinglish: pitiaaee ke anusar, unhonne kah, "hamane khule taura para apana lakshya bataya hai ki 2030 taka rashtriya rina sakala gharelu utpada ke 50 pratishata taka simita rahega। hama kendra sarakara ke rina ko kama karane ke lie lagatara upaya kara rahe hain aura antararashtriya sangathanon ne rina prabandhana ke lie bharata ke anushasita drishtikona ko svikara kiya hai।"

articles.title: Israeli Embassy in India Says Ties Will Remain Steady Despite Election
articles.summary: As Israelis prepare to vote on October 27, the Israeli Embassy in India stated that bilateral relations will remain steady regardless of who forms the next government. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces a closely contested parliamentary election amid regional conflict. The outcome will shape national security priorities and coalition negotiations, but diplomatic ties with New Delhi are expected to endure.
articles.title_hi: भारत में इजरायली दूतावास का कहना है कि चुनाव के बावजूद संबंध स्थिर रहेंगे
articles.summary_hi: जैसा कि इजरायली 27 अक्टूबर को मतदान करने की तैयारी कर रहे हैं, भारत में इजरायली दूतावास ने कहा कि अगली सरकार चाहे किसी की भी बने, द्विपक्षीय संबंध स्थिर रहेंगे। क्षेत्रीय संघर्ष के बीच प्रधान मंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू को संसदीय चुनाव में करीबी मुकाबले का सामना करना पड़ रहा है। इसका परिणाम राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा प्राथमिकताओं और गठबंधन वार्ता को आकार देगा, लेकिन नई दिल्ली के साथ राजनयिक संबंध बने रहने की उम्मीद है।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata men ijarayali dutavasa ka kahana hai ki chunava ke bavajuda sanbandha sthira rahenge

articles.title: India’s Got Latent 2: Narendra Modi Lookalike Takes A Dig At Kunal Kamra During
articles.summary: The fun began when Samay Raina brought the comedian into the act through a video call, giving Raahil, who performed as ‘Odi Ji’, a chance to take a few jabs at him. From a joke about the falling rupee to a cheeky question about Kamra’s comedy, Raahil kept the exchange going.

articles.title: International media reports on Modi handling protests and central bank defending currency
articles.summary: International media outlets recently reported on challenges facing Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, including youth protests and the Reserve Bank of India defending the national currency. Analysts highlighted political risks tied to youth movements and questioned the high financial costs and market restrictions used by the central bank to prevent further currency depreciation.

articles.title: Himachal, Punjab likely to drive INDIA bloc mobilisation for November 1 Delhi rally
articles.summary: Himachal Pradesh and Punjab, two non-BJP-ruled states, are expected to play a key role in mobilising opposition supporters for the INDIA bloc’s November 1 “Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao” rally at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi. The Left’s support among industrial workers and public-sector employees, along with discontent among farmers and apple growers over Centre policies, could aid the effort.

articles.title: India's laser weapons can destroy drones for just a few hundred rupees: Former DRDO
articles.summary: He explained that the immediate cost of firing a laser largely comes down to the electricity consumed in generating the beam. India's DRDO successfully demonstrated its indigenous 30-kilowatt Mk-II(A) laser-directed energy weapon in April 2025 at Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh. The system demonstrated its ability to engage drones and disable surveillance sensors.
